summary: The note introduces aromatherapy, a holistic practice using natural plant extracts via smell and skin absorption, and lists ten essential oils recommended for beginners, as shared by various experts at seminars and workshops in autumn 2023. Each oil is linked to specific benefits, from lavender for sleep to geranium for skin. It closes with advice to research and consult a healthcare professional before use, especially for people with health conditions or pregnant women.
one_line: Overview of aromatherapy and ten beginner-friendly essential oils, their health benefits, and expert advice shared at 2023 events.
key_facts: Aromatherapy is a holistic healing treatment using natural plant extracts, mainly through smell and skin absorption, to unify physiological, psychological, and spiritual processes.
Dr. Emily Robinson, an integrative health specialist, shared the top ten beginner essential oils at a seminar on September 5th, 2023.
A study presented by the Aromatic Plant Research Center on October 14th, 2023, found that diffusing lavender oil in the bedroom before sleep significantly improved sleep quality.
Dr. Jake Thompson highlighted peppermint oil in a workshop on November 2nd, 2023, noting it invigorates the mind, aids digestion and migraines, and can counteract nausea or motion sickness.
Sarah Miller of the National Aromatherapy Society said on September 26th that lemon oil can improve mood and concentration and has antibacterial and antiviral properties.
James Fern, a holistic health coach, explained on September 20th that chamomile oil is good for skin irritations and acts as an anti-inflammatory against eczema or rosacea.
Respiratory therapist Laura Gonzalez shared studies on October 21st, 2023, indicating eucalyptus oil has decongestant properties useful against colds, coughs, and sinusitis.
Dermatologist Dr. Omar Patel said in a webinar on October 30th that tea tree oil can combat acne, dandruff, and fungal infections.
Frankincense, called the "King of Oils," was praised by yoga instructor Anita Desai on November 17th, 2023, for enhancing meditation and reducing stress and anxiety.
Dr. Brian O'Connell said in a September 15th, 2023 lecture that inhaling rosemary oil can boost memory, alertness, and focus.
Sofia Moreno said on September 30th that ylang-ylang oil helps balance emotions and reduce tension and stress.
Dr. Lisa Grant, a skin care expert and GP, said on September 12th that geranium oil is a gentle astringent that can tighten skin and minimize wrinkles when used diluted and consistently.
The note advises consulting a healthcare professional before using essential oils, especially for individuals with specific health conditions or pregnant women.
